text_block_list.text:
One day, when Neo Universe passed by the 
dorm lobby...

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"‘Hello there, viewers at home! Have you 
been feeling a bit sluggish lately?’"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Was the resupply in preparation for 
"EVA"... excessive? Unused "energy" has 
solidified inside the body...

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Was it overeating? Lack of exercise? 
Whatever it is, strike while the iron is 
hot! Let's defy gravity and get back on 
our feet!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“Now, let's begin the exercise! By the 
time we're done, you'll feel like you're 
on the moon!”

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"First, draw an elliptical orbit... 
Alright, blast off, Apollo! Docking! Come 
exercise together♪"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Parabolic"...! With this training... Neo 
Universe can also...

"The next day— I spotted Neo Universe 
diligently doing gymnastics in the Tracen 
Academy courtyard."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for Artemis... "Blast off Apollo, 
docking."

Neo Universe kept up with her exercise and 
successfully lost weight!
